report_name: Kroll Report: 69% of Orgs Breached in Past Year, Most via Third Parties

attack_patterns.name: Supply Chain Compromise
attack_patterns.description: The Kroll 2026 Data Breach Outlook report identified that breaches originating from third-party technology providers had the widest impact, affecting 69% of all individuals impacted in Kroll's incident response cases between June 2025 and June 2026.

identities.name: Kroll
identities.description: Global risk and financial advisory firm that authored the 2026 Data Breach Outlook report, which analyzed data breaches from the past year.
